definition: The actual-concrete carrier is a subtype of the fixed rigid candidate roster whose members satisfy a supplied, theory-relative concreteness predicate and exist somewhere in the selected complete history. The predecessor relation includes only edges between these candidates. Abstract or absent causal sources cannot enter its well-foundedness proof.
note: Analyst-defined #487 conditional semantics, not an established causal or metaphysical premise. Whole histories, rigid cross-world identity, supplied concreteness, and generic causation are independently contestable.
